claims.text: The Chancery Rosewood is an all-suite property with eight restaurants and bars.

findings.quote: The Chancery Rosewood is an all-suite property featuring eight distinctive restaurants and bars.

claims.text: The hotel is at 30 Grosvenor Square in London's Mayfair.

claims.text: The hotel is steps from shopping on Bond Street and Oxford Street, with Selfridges a short walk away.

findings.quote: you're also steps away from some of London's best shopping, on Bond Street and Oxford Street (Selfridge's is a short walk away)

claims.text: The Chancery Rosewood is Rosewood's second London hotel, alongside Rosewood London in Holborn.

findings.quote: Rosewood announced plans to renovate the property to become its second London opening, joining the ranks of Rosewood London in Holborn.

claims.text: Tobi Masa is a Japanese restaurant with an intimate omakase counter and a private dining room.

findings.quote: A Japanese restaurant showcasing the finest seasonal ingredients, with an intimate omakase counter and a private dining room for memorable gatherings.

claims.text: Jacqueline reimagines the British tradition of afternoon tea, with a collection of over 100 teas sourced from around the world.

findings.quote: The British tradition of Afternoon Tea is reimagined at Jacqueline.
featuring a curated collection of over 100 distinctive teas sourced from around the world

claims.text: Jacqueline sits just off the lobby.

findings.quote: Jacqueline, which sits just off the lobby

claims.text: Serra Restaurant & Bar serves Southern Mediterranean cuisine with family-style service.

findings.quote: A lively celebration of Southern Mediterranean cuisine. Serra is a dining destination where warmth, togetherness, and family-style service are at the heart of every experience.

claims.text: Serra's interiors are by New York-based designers AvroKO.

findings.quote: I dined at Serra—lots of curvy lines installed by New York-based designers AvroKO make the ever-blocky space warm and inviting

claims.text: GSQ is a day-to-night cafe with an expansive outdoor terrace that welcomes walk-in guests and offers takeaway.

findings.quote: More than a cafe, GSQ is a day-to-night destination for connection and everyday enjoyment, complete with an expansive outdoor terrace. We welcome guests on a walk-in basis and offer takeaway options for those on the move.

claims.text: Asaya Spa has treatment rooms, a pool, a sauna, a steam room, a hydrozone, a movement studio and a gym.

findings.quote: With five treatment rooms, a 25-metre pool, sauna, steam room, hydrozone, movement studio and cutting-edge gym, Asaya Spa

claims.text: The fitness centre features Artis Luxury equipment and a TechnoGym reformer bed.

findings.quote: Our fitness centre features Artis Luxury equipment and debuts the first reformer bed by TechnoGym for elevated movement.

claims.text: Eagle Bar is a rooftop bar with roof terraces that offer views of Grosvenor Square and Hyde Park.

findings.quote: Perched on the rooftop, Eagle Bar is a destination of effortless elegance, where chic interiors meet expansive roof terraces offering breathtaking views over Grosvenor Square and Hyde Park.

claims.text: The building was designed by Eero Saarinen in 1960 and is a Grade II-listed landmark.

findings.quote: Designed by Eero Saarinen in 1960, The Chancery Rosewood is a Grade II-listed landmark
